notes: This portable C++ TCK contract exercises one regular acquisition denied by the current owner. It verifies the tagged release request, one tagged Attribute Ownership Unavailable callback, a subsequent Query Attribute Ownership report naming the unchanged owner, and the public ownership predicates. The installed-package C++ primary/contract pair passed 4/4 direct runs and 4/4 focused CTests across evoked/immediate callbacks (out/mgw/ownership-denial-query-promoted-20261021.json; out/mgw/cpp-tck-unregulated-timestamped-attribute-20261021). Java source compiles against the official 2025 API JAR, but provider runtime has not run. Scope is limited to this ordinary two-federate path; no multi-acquirer arbitration, RTI-owned state, transport-specific behavior, independent-provider interoperability, or conformance claim is made.
